item.title: Lubbock Black History: Who are the faces of the Roots Mural?

item.title: Federal indictments in West Texas smuggling crash that killed 7-year-old, grandmother and 2 immigrants
item.description: Rassian Comer was federally indicted for conspiring to transport 11 illegal immigrants from Sheffield, Texas to San Antonio, resulting in the death of a 7-year-old girl, her grandmother and two immigrants in a crash in 2023.
